brief:
Palestinian journalists working in Gaza have redefined the meaning of war reporting globally, Shehab Wire reported. Their journalism has transcended professional duty or financial gain to become a mission rooted in sacrifice and service, the outlet said.

The performance of Palestinian journalists in the territory has challenged conventional notions of how news is gathered and reported under conflict, according to the account. Their work reflects commitment to their profession as a calling rather than employment or personal advancement.
dek: Palestinian journalists working in Gaza have redefined the meaning of war reporting globally, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Palestinian journalists redefine war reporting through sacrifice in Gaza
